race.comment: CASSANDRA (10) has made the right start to her career, winning on debut at Pinjarra before closing strongly for third at this track when beaten 0.8L as favourite. She returns off a six-week freshening and Pike sticking is a big tick. Maps to get every chance and can get back to winning ways. TRAILER TRUCK (3) was better than ninth first-up at Kalgoorlie suggests, beaten only three and a half lengths in a Class 2 after settling rearward, and his second-up improvement can bring him right into this. PRODUCIMUS (5) won her Mdn on soft ground at Bunbury before a fair fifth at Northam. Blinkers go on now and she can play a leading role. BEAUMONT MISS (8) can build on a gutsy last start win at Geraldton.
